title: ASaP: Automatic Software Prefetching for Sparse Tensor Computations in MLIR
problem: Sparse tensor computations have irregular memory access patterns that degrade cache performance; existing compiler approaches lack semantic insight for effective prefetching.
motivation: Sparse tensor operations are critical for ML and scientific computing; software prefetching can mitigate cache misses if intelligently placed; MLIR's sparsification provides semantic context.
method: ASaP: automatic software prefetching framework in MLIR's sparse tensor dialect. Leverages tensor format and loop structure information to determine buffer bounds and inject prefetches in inner/outer loops.
key_novelty: Semantic-aware prefetching using MLIR sparsification context; broader coverage via inner+outer-loop prefetching vs prior single-loop approaches.
contributions: ASaP prefetching framework for sparse tensors in MLIR
primary_theme: MLIR-based semantic prefetching for sparse tensor computations
